create_pad_create: create padding arrays using pad.create with causal, full, same, valid, or reverse_causal padding modes
test_pad_causal_padding: test causal padding that prevents output from depending on future inputs
test_pad_same_padding: test same padding that preserves input size for stride=1 convolutions
test_pad_valid_padding: test valid padding with no padding applied to convolutions
test_pad_full_padding: test full padding that maximally pads without convolving over padded elements
